gloss: military service; serving in the army; following the troops

definitions.gloss: military service; accompanying the army; serving at the front
definitions.explanation: Serving in or accompanying a military force, especially in wartime. Used for both soldiers and non-combatants (journalists, nurses) who accompany troops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has experience serving in the military.

examples.japanese: {従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}した→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
examples.english: An embedded journalist reported from the front line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{従軍|じゅうぐん}し、{戦地|せんち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: He served in the military at a young age and learned much in the war zone.

notes:
Composed of {従|じゅう} (to follow, to accompany) + ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (army, military). Originally meant "to follow the army" and can refer to both combatants and non-combatants who accompany military forces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧: war correspondent; embedded journalist
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦{看護婦|かんごふ}→看護婦：01380_kangofu⟧: military nurse (historical)
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: military service experience
- {従軍|じゅうぐん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to serve in the military; to follow the troops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{兵役|へいえき}→兵役：19964_heieki⟧: military service, conscription — focuses on compulsory service
- {出征|しゅっせい}: going to war — emphasizes departing for the battlefield
- ⟦{入隊|にゅうたい}→入隊：12064_nyuutai⟧: enlisting — the act of joining the military
